name: Piero Taruffi
features: olive skin, silver-grey hair, dark eyes, long distinguished face, aquiline nose, lean athletic build, thoughtful engineer's expression
bio: 'The Silver Fox' — an engineer with a doctorate who won the 500cc European motorcycle title for Norton in 1932, set land speed records in his own twin-boom Tarf, and finally won the Mille Miglia in 1957 at the age of 50, in the last running of the race. He retired the moment he crossed the line, as he had promised his wife.
